name: RDS Master Password Reset
description: The RDS master user is the database superuser. Anyone who can change that password owns the data inside, even if they never had an application DB account. The attacker resets the password, connects with the new one, and dumps or alters tables. Applications that used the old password start failing, which is often how teams notice. Master-password changes belong in a secrets-rotation playbook, not an ad-hoc console click.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
